scope: Design projection validator, conditional design trace, recursive prompt-like and sensitive design text diagnostics, projection authority boundary, and PKT-23 locked module boundary.

evidence.risk: Design projection claims Ready For Code, release, closeout, User UAT, residual-risk, productization, requirement, packet-bypass, or acceptance authority.
evidence.evidence: validate_design_projection emits design_projection_authority_claim_forbidden and focused tests cover Ready For Code, approve release, bypass packet gate, close acceptance, nested design-text approval overclaims, and plural natural-language variants such as requirements are approved, bypasses packets, approval gates are bypassed, and creates requirements.

evidence.risk: Prompt-like design text enters handoff or validator surfaces as instruction.
evidence.evidence: validate_design_projection recursively scans projection text and emits design_projection_prompt_like for nested instruction-like design, mockup, and browser expectation notes.

evidence.risk: Sensitive screen/design data is reused in evidence or handoff without being flagged.
evidence.evidence: validate_design_projection recursively scans projection text and emits design_projection_sensitive_text for nested password/token/API-key style text.

evidence.risk: PKT-22 absorbs PKT-23 locked reusable UI module authority.
evidence.evidence: Implementation validates module classification metadata only and emits locked_module_contract_out_of_scope when PKT-23 locked module fields such as doNotChangeRules or visualReference are supplied.

residualRisks.description: Text-pattern authority scanning may need new negative fixtures if future packets add new authority vocabulary.
residualRisks.disposition: non-blocking maintenance risk; current PKT-22 authority variants are covered by focused tests

residualRisks.description: PKT-22 does not implement locked reusable UI module contracts.
residualRisks.disposition: preserve PKT-23 ownership of locked module enforcement
